text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's Day and we're heading to
a shrine
for our first visit of the year.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have sighted Teio and
McQueen.

I look toward the display TV in the
electronics
store that Mihono Bourbon is
pointing at.

text_block_list.name: Teio and McQueen
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!
Tokai Teio and Mejiro McQueen are appearing on a program called New Year's Umamusume Special.

It looks like a talk show where they
discuss this
year's races and the runners
who are expected to
make headlines.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
So, both Mihono Bourbon and Rice
Shower are
about to enter their senior
year.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
They've become quite the hot topic
within the
racing community. Do you
think we should keep
an eye on those
two?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, good question. Personally, I've
had my eye
on Bourbon since she ran in
the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And everyone's been comparing her to
me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So I think it's worth showing up to watch
one of
her races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my. In that case, I'll likely be
competing
against both of them in the
upcoming spring
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Really? Think you can take the heat?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Whatever is that supposed to mean?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware of the rumors
surrounding
Bourbon and Rice, as well as
their true abilities.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But it doesn't stop me from running in
my usual
way.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
True, true. Well, I suppose I'll root for
ya!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You should take this more seriously,
Teio! You're
talking like it's a game!

Their banter livens up the studio as the
special
continues.

I'm curious about what will happen next,
but we
need to hurry before it gets dark
out.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Affirmative, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Bow twice, clap twice, bow once...
Shrine worship
executed without error.

Mihono Bourbon performs her prayer
with ample
vigor, leaving me curious as
to what she wished
for.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: To win in my senior year.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm entering my senior year, I
determined
this to be a suitable wish for
my shrine visit.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, a causal relationship between
prayer
and victory has not been
scientifically proven...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, Mejiro McQueen and Tokai
Teio are
both overwhelmingly talented.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is essential that I continue my training
in order
to compete on the same level as
them.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I understand that today is a day off, but
I am
eager to train.

This sudden rise in determination was
probably
sparked by that TV special we
saw earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rest up? But...
choice_data_list: 今日はしっかり休もう
おみくじで運気アップ！
新たな技を身につけよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's get plenty of rest today.
Boost your luck with a fortune slip!

text_block_list.text:
I tell her to rest today so that she's
prepared for
some harsh training
tomorrow.
choice_data_list: 休みも大事なトレーニングだ
休みも大事なトレーニングだよ
choice_data_list_en: Rest is an important part of training, too.
Rest is an important part of training too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order acknowledged. I will recuperate
today.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Before I begin... how do you suggest I go
about
recuperating?
And off we go.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, look at how high that kite is
soaring.

We're able to spend a relaxing New
Year's Day
together.

With tough opponents waiting for us in
the near
future, I want to work even
harder than ever
together to make sure
we have a shot at beating
them!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Boost our luck with a fortune slip? Order

acknowledged.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, I do not understand how a
piece of
paper can increase my luck.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
And what exactly is "fortune" to begin
with?

Despite her being lost in a maze of
questions, I
manage to persuade Mihono
Bourbon to draw a
fortune slip.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It says "great fortune."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you?

At the very least, we're able to spend a
peaceful
New Year's Day together.

With tough opponents waiting for us in
the near
future, I want to work even
harder than ever
together to make sure
we have a shot at beating
them!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Learn a new running technique? Order

acknowledged.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I shall devise, memorize, and execute a
new
running technique that will be
invaluable for my
senior year.

After she's done, we hurry back to the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The cause is unknown, but the
atmosphere today
is more "pleasant"
than usual.

Bourbon continues striving to perfect her
new
technique until she is completely
satisfied.

With tough opponents waiting for us in
the near
future, I want to work even
harder than ever
together to make sure
we have a shot at beating
them!
